rationale: CAKE gapped down sharply on earnings but has recovered strongly from the session low of $97.55 to $105.81, now trading at 80.8% of today's range and above both VWAP ($104.47) and the 9-EMA ($104.50), indicating buyers have absorbed the initial selling pressure.
